items.rationale: Sections 2.3.2 and 5.2.2 cover necessary recovery attendance and cutting the seized lock, subject to confirmation that theft at the location was covered. An estimated €210 gross for the whole line takes €175 of the €500 mobility limit under 4.2.2, based on €600 in estimated eligible costs.

Sections 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.9 cover necessary repairs to the theft-damaged frame and brakes at the pre-loss standard, up to the bicycle’s insurable value. The estimated €300 gross for both repairs is reduced rateably to €250 under 4.2.2.

Sections 5.2.2(b) and 7.1.7(d)–(e) cover necessary labour and materials attributable to recovery or repair, but 7.1.8(g) bars charges already included in the first two lines. An estimated €90 gross in distinct, substantiated costs takes €75 of the shared limit; no deductible amount is supplied.
